images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A 2D side-scrolling platformer drawn entirely in graphite pencil on a cream ruled notebook page: pale blue rule lines, a double red margin line on the left, punched binder holes along the left edge, soft paper fibers and grain. The world is hand-sketched with hatching and wobbly multi-pass pencil lines: a small house with a smoking chimney, a round-canopy tree, low hills, clouds, a sun with ray strokes. The only colored object is the hero, a small pink rubber eraser in a blue paper sleeve with two dot eyes, rubbing against a tall hatched brick wall. The lower part of the wall is being erased: grey smudges, faded half-lines and a dashed red circular erase cursor labelled '−3%', with pink and grey eraser crumbs flying and piling on the ground line. To the right, a single pencil rope bridge crosses a dark hatched ravine. Red pencil margin notes list what was erased. Top HUD: page title '뒷산 가는 길', a shrinking eraser meter '남은 지우개 62%', a red warning tag '지운 선은 돌아오지 않는다'. Soft daylight, gentle vignette, tactile paper texture. Number constraints: the red margin list reads exactly "벽돌 −3%", "다리 난간 −20%", "구름 일부 −10%", "풀 −5%", "총 −38%", consistent with "남은 지우개 62%"; the lower part of the brick wall is visibly half-erased with grey smudges.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The final page of the same pencil-drawn notebook platformer. On the left cliff stands the eraser hero, now worn down to a tiny pink nub with a sad face. In front of it, a wide ravine where the bridge used to be: only a faint grey ghost smudge of the erased bridge remains, with a red pencil note '건널 선이 없다'. On the far right cliff, drawn in bright waxy colored crayon in contrast to the grey graphite world, a child in a yellow raincoat sits inside a pencil picket fence with a sketchbook on the lap, holding a green crayon toward the gap; crayon flowers and an orange crayon sun. A large real yellow wooden pencil lies diagonally across the page from the right edge, casting a soft shadow, its sharpened tip hovering over the gap. A hand-drawn speech bubble from the child reads '다리를 지운 게 너였구나'. The eraser meter blinks red '6%'. Bottom: two paper choice cards, '남은 몸으로 아이의 울타리를 지운다' and '아무것도 지우지 않고 기다린다'. Quiet, tender, warm cream paper, soft vignette.
